race.comment: ALL SO CLEAR (1) was a narrow winner two back at Pakenham Synthetic in this grade and followed it up with a good effort at Mildura back onto turf in a BM70. He's yet to miss the quinella on synthetic with two runner-up efforts here and draws for every chance. AHAB (4) has just found one better his past two since a win over this route. He's racing very well and will be up on speed, hard to run down once more. KAWA (7) is going well, not far behind AHAB when they met here last start. She'll likely give that horse a start again but will be running on. KICKING KING (3) is off a 15-month break, having placed in a VRC St Leger when last seen. Clearly will be rusty so the market will be the best guide. LOVE SPARKLES (5) presents third up and should be ready to fire now, each way.
